name: hq-chess
title: Chess
description: A chessboard two members play on while others watch.
longDescription: Place a chessboard from the map editor (on a table, for instance), walk up to it and press X. Take White or Black, or watch; pieces are dragged and dropped, with no rules checked, and either player can take the last move back. Each board keeps its game and its two players until somebody resets it: a seated player who has the board open, or anybody when neither player has it open.
